symbolDescription: Props of `Globe` and `GlobeLazy`. Every prop is optional.

optionDescriptions.width: Container width, applied to its inline style.
optionDescriptions.height: Container height, applied to its inline style. The container must end up with a size.
optionDescriptions.enableZoom: Wheel and pinch zoom. When false no wheel listener is attached at all, so the page behind scrolls normally.
optionDescriptions.minZoom: Closest allowed distance from the globe's centre, in globe radii.
optionDescriptions.maxZoom: Farthest allowed distance from the globe's centre, in globe radii.
optionDescriptions.enableRotation: Left-drag orbit, with inertia on release.
optionDescriptions.enableTilt: Right-drag (or shift + left-drag) tilt, pivoting on the grabbed point.
optionDescriptions.camera: Controlled camera: each change animates the camera there. Wins over `defaultCamera`.
optionDescriptions.defaultCamera: Uncontrolled starting pose, and the pose `reset()` returns to. Unset members fall back to `{ lat: 20, lng: 0, zoom: 3.2, tilt: 0 }`.
optionDescriptions.defaultCenter: Where the globe opens, as a coordinate. A convenience over `defaultCamera` for the common case of "point it at this place"; `defaultCamera` wins where both name a latitude and longitude. Also the point `reset()` returns to.
optionDescriptions.showControls: Built-in rotate, zoom and reset buttons.
optionDescriptions.showCountryNames: Country names as DOM labels, with collision avoidance.
optionDescriptions.capitalsMinZoom: Capitals render only while `zoom <= capitalsMinZoom`; beyond it they are culled, not faded.
optionDescriptions.countryNamesMinZoom: Country names render only while `zoom <= countryNamesMinZoom`; 0 or less means no threshold.
optionDescriptions.countryHighlightColor: The hover fill. A single colour applies to every style; an object sets it per style, and any style left out keeps the module's default for it — no one colour reads over both a physical map and a neon one.
optionDescriptions.showCountryNameOnHover: A tooltip naming the country under the cursor. Ignored when `showCountryNames` is true.
optionDescriptions.showGraticule: Meridians and parallels every 15 degrees, drawn on the sphere.
optionDescriptions.showGraticuleLabels: Degree labels along the equator and the prime meridian. Needs `showGraticule`.
optionDescriptions.colorScheme: `grayscale` desaturates the globe in its shaders; pins, labels and popups keep their colour.
optionDescriptions.showClouds: The drifting cloud shell. Only `'realistic'` has one to show.
optionDescriptions.assets: Replacements for bundled textures and datasets.
optionDescriptions.backgroundColor: Any CSS colour, `'transparent'`, or a `var(--token)` read off the container.
optionDescriptions.pins: Markers placed at exact coordinates and hidden behind the globe.
optionDescriptions.pinComponent: Draws each visible, unclustered pin as your own DOM element instead of the built-in WebGL marker.
optionDescriptions.showPinPopup: A popup anchored to the hovered pin, flipped to stay inside the canvas.
optionDescriptions.enablePinClustering: Merges pins that crowd together on screen.
optionDescriptions.clusterZoomThreshold: Pins cluster while the camera is farther than this distance.
optionDescriptions.connectionType: The default shape. A connection's own `type` overrides it.
optionDescriptions.archHeight: Peak lift of an arch above the surface, in globe radii, for an antipodal pair; shorter hops scale down with distance. A connection's own `archHeight` overrides it.
optionDescriptions.connectionLineStyle: The default stroke pattern. A connection's own `lineStyle` overrides it.
optionDescriptions.connectionWidth: The default stroke width in pixels, constant across zoom. A connection's own `width` overrides it.
optionDescriptions.connectionColor: The default stroke colour. A connection's own `color` overrides it.
optionDescriptions.connectionComponent: Draws connections as your own SVG instead of the built-in WebGL lines. `DefaultConnection` is a valid value.
optionDescriptions.locale: Language for the built-in UI strings and for country and capital names, as a BCP 47 tag ('de', 'de-AT'). Built-in: 'en', 'ro', 'de', 'es', 'fr', 'hu'. Any other language still picks place names from a dataset that carries them, with English UI strings unless `messages` supplies every one.
optionDescriptions.messages: Replaces any built-in UI string for the current locale.

eventDescriptions.onCameraChange: Fires on every pose change, including drags.
eventDescriptions.onCountryHover: Fires when the hovered country changes; null when the pointer leaves every country.
eventDescriptions.onCountryClick: Fires for a press that was not a drag (4 px of travel or less) on a country.
eventDescriptions.onPinHover: Fires when the hovered pin changes; null when the pointer leaves every pin.
eventDescriptions.onPinClick: Fires for a press that was not a drag on a pin; the click also toggles the pin's `selected` state.
eventDescriptions.onClusterClick: Replaces the default cluster action, a flight that fits the cluster's pins.
eventDescriptions.onReady: Fires once, after the engine exists, with the imperative handle.
eventDescriptions.onError: Fires when WebGL is unavailable, the context is lost, a dataset fails to load, or rendering throws. The globe shows a wordless fallback.
